text:
ITEM 1 | Rectangular/triangular pieces with an orange-red tomato-sauce topping over pale cream-white cheese-like layer, bubbly and slightly browned at edges, soft and moist, sitting on a flat golden-tan crust-like base; covers roughly 25% of plate in the upper-left center, about 12 cm across and 2 cm thick | 150

ITEM 2 | Irregular chunk with pale white-cream interior and orange-red sauce coating on outer surface, bumpy and folded texture, soft and moist, sitting at upper-right of plate; about 7 cm by 6 cm footprint and 4 cm tall | 110

ITEM 3 | Thin golden-tan crust-like piece partly tucked under the tomato-cheese portion at upper-left, flat with slightly browned surface, about 4 cm by 3 cm | 25

ITEM 4 | Several sliced pieces of brown-to-reddish-pink meat with darker seared outer edges and visible speckled seasoning, slightly moist, firm, sliced cross-sections, lying in a cluster at lower-left of plate covering about 15% of plate; largest slice about 7 cm long and 2.5 cm thick | 130

ITEM 5 | Small scattered orange-red sauce specks and crumbs on the plate surface near the meat and left edge, dry and sparse | 5
